_comment: Inkshadow: the lead Spirling walks one step behind the Wayfarer and mutters a remark now and then. Read by scripts/core/Inkshadow.gd. A battle the lead ends fainted adds one grudge mark; from grudge_sour marks on, its remarks come from the sour pool. A Spirling with no grudge sometimes finds coins.

fierce: %s glares at a bush as if it owes money.
%s practises biting the air. The air loses.
stalwart: %s plants its feet. Nothing is attacking. It plants them anyway.
%s walks exactly in your footprints, just in case.
keen: %s counts the fence posts. Twice. One is missing.
%s stares at the map ink until it smudges.
brisk: %s runs ahead, runs back, and pretends it never left.
hearty: %s eats something off the path. It seems fine. Probably.
even: %s keeps pace, calm as a closed coffin.
%s watches the clouds drift and judges none of them.
curious: %s sniffs a grave marker and looks very interested.
%s prods a puddle. The puddle prods back.
shy: %s hides behind your boot from a leaf.
%s steps on your shadow so nobody sees it.
proud: %s struts like it won the last battle alone.
%s nods at strangers as if they owe it a bow.
gentle: %s steers a beetle off the path.
%s leans against your leg for a moment.

sour: %s walks a little too close behind you. Like a knife does.
%s mutters the names of everyone you let fall. Yours is on the list too.
%s steps on your heel. Twice. On purpose.
%s practises a farewell speech. It is about you.
finds: %s digs up a few coins and drops them at your feet. %d coins!
